 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
% 19.05.2023 1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
1. This petition has been filed seeking regular bail in FIR No.68/2022 PS Cyber Rohini under sections 419/420/468/471 IPC.
2. Issue notice.
Ld. APP for the State accepts notice.
3. Status report be filed before the next date of hearing.

4. Latest nominal roll of the appellant be called for from the concerned Jail Superintendent and be placed on record before the next date of hearing.
5.
The petitioner is in custody since 22nd September, 2022.
Charge-sheet has been filed.

6. List on 27th July, 2023.
7.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 19, 2023/sm
